title: Toasts Unevenly, Barely Toasts on Highest Setting
text:
Toasts Unevenly, Barely Toasts on Highest Setting. After my much-loved Hamilton Beach Digital 4-Slice Toaster developed a short (after long use), I purchased this HAMILTON BEACH 4-SLICE EXTRA WIDE SLOT TOASTER (with Defrost and Bagel Functions, Shade Selector, Toast Boost, Auto-Shutoff and Cancel Button, Black (24633)) as a replacement. What a disappointment!

It’s hard to select the toasting time, because the printed shade selector numbers and pointer are small and faint. Frozen bread barely toasts when the shade selector is set to 6 or the maximum 7. The toaster toasts the bread unevenly (only the top half), and mostly toasts only on one side. When I toasted English muffins, one muffin failed to pop up at the end of the cycle, even though the muffin went in smoothly.

The crumb trays, which should be emptied weekly, are inconveniently placed. To empty them, you must unplug the toaster and turn it upside down over a sink or garbage receptacle.

Because I’ve owned many excellent Hamilton Beach toasters in the past, I have to wonder whether this particular toaster model is a counterfeit knockoff. The design flaws I can live with, but the performance is barely there when the toaster is brand new.
